description: A large column of rough-dressed men and women marches across a muddy hillside under a stormy grey sky. A man in a dark hooded monk's habit walks at the centre, with a bearded man in a cap holding a tattered dark-red banner aloft. The banner shows a golden chalice, a red heart with a golden glow, and pale hands and feet with red blood drips at the edges. Behind them a stone abbey with a square tower sits on a hill, with smoke rising. Pikes, staves and a cross are visible in the crowd. No text, no frame.
